claims.text: Subconjunctival bevacizumab may help prevent progression when used with excision + conjunctival autograft, and to treat recurrence
claims.quote: Subconjunctival injections of an anti-VEGF medication (eg, bevacizumab) under a pterygium may be useful to prevent progression and improve outcomes when used with pterygium excision plus conjunctival autograft and to treat recurrent pterygium
